description: Tell a meeting bot that is currently in a call to leave. Whatever it recorded up to that point is still processed into a transcript — this ends the recording, it does not discard it. Identify the bot by transcription_id or job_id from list_scheduled_meetings. Requires `login`.

job_id.description: The meeting-bot job id. Either this or transcription_id.

transcription_id.description: The transcription the bot is recording into.

name: stop_meeting_bot
